spec.description: Desired namespace settings and ownership metadata used by the platform.

behavior: Creates a Kubernetes Namespace with standard labels applied.
Deletion behavior follows the composition's deletion policy.
gotchas: Namespace names must be DNS-1123 compatible and unique per cluster.

name.description: Namespace name to create in the target cluster. Must be DNS-1123 compatible.

tier.description: Tier used to select defaults like quota and policy behavior.

cluster.description: Logical cluster identifier used for labeling and placement.

owner.description: Owning team or service for accountability and routing.
